name: Plumbscourge
description: Lifts the weight from below in a rising arc that clips the chin of a foe standing square.

name: Unbowed Weightneck
description: Stands a measured pace back and turns a descending cut aside on the taut cord.

name: Might Longrope
description: Rises onto the toes and steps lightly forward as the weight climbs overhead.

name: Cablerespite
description: Reads the foe's weight and breath through the tension of the raised cord.

name: Tempered Spinout
description: Drops the weight from full height in one clean descent with qi driving the iron.

name: Gyve Plummet
description: Binds a foe's arms inside a high orbit of cord that tightens as it turns.

name: Pitiless Ropehead
description: Strikes upward with the weight and falls back a pace as it descends for a second blow.

name: Rumble Loopend
description: Brings the weight down from the peak of its flight with qi that breaks shield and rib alike.

name: Wicked Cordsplice
description: Casts a wide net of qi-hardened cord that falls across a path and entangles all who run into it.

name: Merciless Tempered Tailstone
description: Gathers qi at the crown of a long overhead orbit and drops the weight in one shattering fall.

name: Rumble Meteorhead
description: Enters both orbits at once with the weight on one track and the cord end on the other.

name: Impervious Weighttip
description: Spins the left-hand track in a closed ring that shields the flank.

name: Gust Gyre
description: Casts down the right-hand track to the rope's full length at the foe's lead shoulder.

name: Torrent Slingshot
description: Steps across the line where the two tracks meet to arrive at the foe's blind side.

name: Remnant Dropweight
description: Seems to commit to one track and then fires the other in the same breath.

name: Plumbwrath
description: Runs both orbits together and lets the weight fall through the gap between the foe's guards.

name: Ponderous Longrope
description: Crosses the two tracks about the foe's limbs and draws them tight with a pull of qi.

name: Mayhem Revolve
description: Cracks the cord twice in quick beats against a weapon hand and spoils the grip.

name: Equipoise Tailstone
description: Draws one orbit across an incoming cut and answers with the weight on the other track.

name: Slagponderer
description: Spins both tracks in a pair of great rings of qi that crush all who stand in the basin of the swing.

name: Granite Weighttip
description: Closes weight and cord on the foe from two sides and breaks his guard in the pincer.

name: Gnashing Plummet
description: Brings both tracks to a single point and lands weight and cord together in one overwhelming blow.

name: Gyrewrath
description: Tosses the weight in a high arc that the foe must watch while the cord swings low.

name: Torrent Reelback
description: Slips off the line of the falling weight and sets up its rebound from the ground.

name: Ponderernerve
description: Hauls the rope hand over hand and screens the body with the returning iron.

name: Iron Slingshot
description: Lets the weight rebound from the first blow and drops it again on the same spot.

name: Immobilizing Orbitband
description: Plunges the weight beside the foe's feet and snares both legs on the swinging cord.

name: Unassailable Cordsplice
description: Takes a blow on the cord and uses the weight's rebound from the ground to strike back.

name: Rumble Orbitband
description: Throws a first fall as a feint and a second as a narrow column of qi that pierces guard and plate.

name: Unconquered Dropweight
description: Spreads the orbit like folded wings to shield the body from arrows and lunges.

name: Wrathful Gyre Havoc
description: Hurls the weight so high that its fall and its rebound from the earth both strike the ground around.

name: Pondererruin
description: Casts the weight along the rim of the ground the cultivator claims and strikes whoever steps over it.

name: Pondererwrath
description: Sweeps the weight along the floor of the ground and takes the legs from beneath a charge.

name: Cableglare
description: Steps out at the mouth of a rush and lets the weight carry the turn.

name: Chimeplumb
description: Snaps the cord so that its crack rings back from the ground and unsettles the foe's footing.

name: Charter Loopend
description: Walks the rim of the swing with the weight turning at the shoulder to screen all sides.

name: Downpour Ropehead
description: Fills the whole ground around the cultivator with orbits of qi-driven iron.

name: Fastening Revolve
description: Hauls a caught foe along the ground in a long steady pull like a river running.

name: Tempered Reelback
description: Slams the weight into one side and again into the other in a single beat.

name: Weightneck Tenacity
description: Kicks up the loose ground with the weight's pass and hides the real line of the blow.

name: Blaze Orbitband
description: Gathers qi in the iron through a slow turn and casts it down on a single foe with crushing weight.

name: Punishing Spinout
description: Pours qi into the orbit until it overflows its ring and strikes foes well beyond it.

name: Toxin Meteorhead
description: Lays a long line of qi-charged cord across the ground that snares every foot that crosses it.

name: Siltplumb
description: Casts the weight from the center in a great ring that sweeps the whole ground of every foe.

name: Pitiless Cordsplice
description: Opens a run of blows with a first stroke that starts the weight flowing round the body.

name: Meteorhead Nerve
description: Sends a ripple down the cord to turn a thrust aside before it meets the body.

name: Gust Revolve
description: Pivots in a small eddy about the lead foot to leave the line of a charge.

name: Hogtying Ropehead
description: Pulls a cord-caught arm along the current of the swing until the foe is off balance.

name: Facet Loopend
description: Lets the weight drift in a slow quiet ring that screens the body between exchanges.

name: Rumble Spinout
description: Chains three blows so that each stroke ends where the next begins with no pause.

name: Strangling Longrope
description: Drags a wrapped limb back and down like an undertow and takes the foe's footing.

name: Murkcable
description: Breaks a charge on the weight like rapids on a rock and answers with a crushing swing.

name: Whorlruin
description: Surges the orbit outward in repeated floods of qi-driven iron that strike all in reach.

name: Rumbleplumb
description: Drives the weight into one point of a guard until it caves in like an undercut bank.

name: Ironwhorl
description: Brings two streams of orbit together at the foe and breaks them on him in a single crash.

name: Mightponderer
description: Raises the weight and its trailing cord together like two hawks lifting from the ground.

name: Numbing Slingshot
description: Taps the cord end against the foe's eyes and wrist to draw his guard aside.

name: Plumbvortex
description: Steps into the foe's blind side as the shadow of the weight passes across him.

name: Charter Dropweight
description: Sweeps the cord out like a wing and draws blows away from the body.

name: Rumble Gyre
description: Crosses two stoops in the air so that the weight arrives from a direction the foe has not guarded.

name: Ponderous Weightneck
description: Snatches a raised weapon with a hooked cord and pulls it clear of the foe's hand.

name: Hour Weighttip
description: Holds the weight hovering above the foe so that he dares not advance or turn.

name: Facet Plummet
description: Stoops weight and cord together on one point with qi massed behind the iron.

name: Decimating Tailstone
description: Throws the weight high and lets it fall in a series of rebounds over a wide stretch of ground.

name: Tempered Weightneck
description: Holds two stoops in the air through a long still breath and brings them down as one blow.

name: Gustcable
description: Casts the weight with the wind at its back so that it travels the full length of the rope.

name: Chime Orbitband
description: Feels the pull of the wind along the cord and corrects the bearing before the throw.

name: Plumbglare
description: Drops the shoulder against the gust and slides aside while the weight covers the line.

name: Flintlike Ropehead
description: Braces the rope against the push of the wind and holds it as a guard before the chest.

name: Cablenerve
description: Tugs a tethered limb sharply when a gust leans the foe the wrong way.

name: Punishing Loopend
description: Lets the wind bend the weight's flight round a shield onto the unguarded side.

name: Gyve Spinout
description: Throws the rope in the wind's own swirl until it winds about a foe's arms and legs.

name: Unbowed Cordsplice
description: Turns a cut on the cord and snaps the weight back across the wind into the attacker.

name: Wrathful Reelback
description: Gathers sworn qi against the wind and casts the weight that falls with a crash on the foe.

name: Granite Meteorhead
description: Rides repeated casts down the wind in a volley that keeps a distant foe pinned to the ground.

name: Rumblecable
description: Speaks the vow and sends the weight on a bearing the wind bears to its mark without fail.

name: Mangling Longrope
description: Holds a single line of bearing through the swing and lands the weight on it.

name: Thorn Tailstone
description: Faces the gale square and keeps the cord turning in a guard before the face.

name: Silt Gyre
description: Steps in a straight line along the bearing and lets neither wind nor foe turn it.

name: Tempered Revolve
description: Runs the orbit along the bearing so that a gust cannot throw the weight off line.

name: Fastening Weighttip
description: Locks the cord about the foe's weapon and holds it on one bearing against his pull.

name: Rumble Dropweight
description: Whips the rope with the gust to break the rhythm of a charging foe.

name: Hellish Plummet
description: Drives the weight down the held bearing with qi massed behind it through a guard.

name: Pondererscourge
description: Sweeps the orbit round with the gale's own force and strikes every foe standing in the gust.

name: Tailstone Wrath
description: Holds the bearing through a gale that bends everything else and lets the weight fall true.

name: Irongyre
description: Swings the weight in wide strokes that need nothing near to snag the cord.

name: Granite Ropehead
description: Strides long across hard high ground with the weight swinging free behind the body.

name: Toxin Loopend
description: Lifts the cord against a gust to knock a foe's raised blade off its line.

name: Whorlspine
description: Spins the weight in a guard that needs no shelter to turn missiles.

name: Gyveponderer
description: Hides the cord in long grass and pulls it taut across a charging foe's shins.

name: Eviscerating Slingshot
description: Throws the weight on the wind so that it lands with a crash on the guard.

name: Rumble Longrope
description: Lashes the cord with the wind and stings eyes and hands to break a charge.

name: Chime Weightneck
description: Throws the weight under the open sky at a foe far across the plain.

name: Equipoise Weighttip
description: Stands on the sworn ground and turns a cut aside and then drives the weight into the attacker.

name: Dismantling Slingshot
description: Raises a storm of orbits on the wind that lashes all foes across the open ground.

name: Glint Orbitband
description: Gathers the force of the wind in the iron through a slow cast and drives it through armor.

name: Pondererhavoc
description: Fixes the last bearing with all the wind behind it and ends the exchange in one blow.

name: Tempered Meteorhead
description: Swings the iron on bare high ground where the only cover is the speed of the weight.

name: Blinding Reelback
description: Fixes the eye on the horizon and steps along that bearing with the weight at the hip.

name: Granite Dropweight
description: Turns the iron and cord together in a guard that needs no hand free to hold.

name: Chime Reelback
description: Flicks the cord through dust to sting the eyes and spoil the foe's aim.

name: Vengeful Spinout
description: Slams the iron down with the whole body behind it and nothing in the way of the fall.

name: Hogtying Plummet
description: Hooks the cord over a foe's weapon arm and drags him across the open ground.

name: Equipoise Orbitband
description: Cuts an orbit across an attack and counters at the opening it leaves.

name: Blaze Gyre
description: Casts the iron high so that it comes down in a rain of rebounds across the ground.

name: Lancing Tailstone
description: Lets the iron fall in a single narrow column with qi packed behind it through the target.

name: Eviscerating Dropweight
description: Throws the iron so far along a held bearing that the foe is struck before he sees it fall.

name: Aegis Cordsplice
description: Holds the cord on its bearing against rain and gust and keeps the weight turning.

name: Whorlflash
description: Steps into the squall rather than away and uses its push to quicken the swing.

name: Invincible Loopend
description: Turns a cut aside on a wet cord that is held taut against the slippery weight.

name: Meteorhead Respite
description: Taps the weight against the ground and reads a foe's approach through the thunder.

name: Mayhem Slingshot
description: Snaps the cord in the squall's pause and jolts a weapon hand open.

name: Blazecable
description: Smashes the orbit down with the storm's weight and qi in the iron.

name: Fastening Plummet
description: Hooks the cord on a limb in a flash and hauls on the same line.

name: Gust Cordsplice
description: Rides the gale's wake back through the foe's turn and lands the weight on his flank.

name: Facetplumb
description: Settles into the still center of the orbit and shields the body from every side.

name: Spinout Havoc
description: Hurls the weight again and again down the held bearing so that no foe can lift his head.

name: Ropehead Durance
description: Lays a long taut cord at the line of a squall to trip and tangle any rush across it.

name: Revolve Devastation
description: Holds the bearing through a long still pause and casts the weight with a thunderclap through the guard.

name: Whorlhavoc
description: Swings through the full storm without bending the bearing and lands the weight on its mark.

name: Corroding Revolve
description: Begins the long orbit with a wide first swing that gathers the wind to the weight.

name: Blinding Longrope
description: Walks a slow circle beneath the orbit as the wind pulls at the cord.

name: Torrent Tailstone
description: Opens the orbit at one point to catch a cut on the cord and closes it again.

name: Overbearing Weighttip
description: Draws a caught foe round the whole orbit until he lands in the weight's path.

name: Whorldurance
description: Bends the cord on a gust so that it wraps round a guard from behind.

name: Cableruin
description: Waits for the gap in a foe's attack and sends the weight through it in a single pass.

name: Blaze Weightneck
description: Keeps the orbit growing on the wind until every foe near is struck in turn.

name: Blaze Reelback
description: Gathers the wind into the weight through a long swing and crushes the guard with one fall.

name: Gnashing Tempered Orbitband
description: Closes the great orbit and drops the whole gathered gale into the weight on a single foe.
